samples_reviewed.question_text: The number 470 is written in words as 'four hundred seventy-one'. True or False?
Write the number: seven hundred ten.
Write the number: six hundred five.
The number written as 'seven hundred seventeen' is 718. True or False?
Write the number: eight hundred twenty-one.
Write the number: three hundred fifty.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Both directions of the competency are exercised and kept in balance: numerals are converted into words and word forms are converted back into numerals, with true-or-false items checking a proposed pairing. The learner is doing reading and writing of numerals rather than arithmetic.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The tricky structural cases are represented rather than avoided. A number with a zero in the tens place appears as six hundred five, a number with a zero in the ones place appears in the seven-hundred-ten item, and hyphenated compound tens appear in the eight hundred twenty-one item.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Stems are four or five words long and ask for a single conversion with no embedded context. Hyphenated word forms such as eighty-seven are standard Grade 2 spelling targets, and no item requires holding more than one numeral in mind at a time.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Three response types appear across only eight samples, and the verification orientation genuinely differs from the production orientation: judging whether a stated word form matches a numeral is a different act from generating either one. Both conversion directions occur in more than one format.

competency_alignment.rationale: Difficulty tracks the structural complexity of the numeral itself, moving from a round hundred-and-tens form up to compound hyphenated forms and forms containing an internal zero. That is the dimension that makes reading and writing three-digit numerals hard, so the progression is on-competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: All eight samples live between the low two-hundreds and the low eight-hundreds. The nine-hundreds never occur and 1000 itself, the one numeral whose reading and writing the stated bound singles out, appears in neither a stem nor a key nor an option, so the top of the range goes untested.
